system.boundary: Build a physically causal reversible residential heat-pump system using a two-phase refrigerant loop with a variable-capacity compressor, indoor and outdoor heat exchangers, an electronic expansion valve, a four-way reversing valve, an accumulator, circulation fans, and a moist-air house thermal load.
engineering_objects: Build a physically causal reversible residential heat-pump system using a two-phase refrigerant loop with a variable-capacity compressor, indoor and outdoor heat exchangers, an electronic expansion valve, a four-way reversing valve, an accumulator, circulation fans, and a moist-air house thermal load.
The same plant must provide heating in cold ambient conditions and cooling in hot ambient conditions.

Temperature errors and operating-condition changes must propagate through controller commands, compressor and valve actuation, refrigerant pressure and mass flow, heat-exchanger heat flow, electrical power, and house temperature.
physical_paths: Temperature errors and operating-condition changes must propagate through controller commands, compressor and valve actuation, refrigerant pressure and mass flow, heat-exchanger heat flow, electrical power, and house temperature.

Build a physically causal reversible residential heat-pump system using a two-phase refrigerant loop with a variable-capacity compressor, indoor and outdoor heat exchangers, an electronic expansion valve, a four-way reversing valve, an accumulator, circulation fans, and a moist-air house thermal load.
The same plant must provide heating in cold ambient conditions and cooling in hot ambient conditions.
functional_paths: Regulate the measured house-air temperature in closed loop to T_set, select heating or cooling as conditions require, reverse the refrigerant path consistently with the selected mode, and protect the refrigerant loop from unsafe pressure operation.

modes_and_events: Regulate the measured house-air temperature in closed loop to T_set, select heating or cooling as conditions require, reverse the refrigerant path consistently with the selected mode, and protect the refrigerant loop from unsafe pressure operation.
